uncertainty: No target evidence is supplied, so actual log completeness, timestamp meaning, and discriminating power of the proposed checks in the scoped workflow and window remain unobserved beyond the mapping's stated assumptions.

mechanism_fidelity.rationale: Preserves state->operation->signal->inference and limits: state holds multiple mechanisms per handoff open including residual (k); operation builds differential before discriminating evidence, pre-states predictions, gathers in discriminating-power order and iteratively re-ranks; signal is supports/contradicts/non-discriminating matrix pattern; inference narrows/retains/eliminates without single-cause closure and allows coexistence; limits carry coverage, evidence quality/independence, unknown sensitivity/specificity, anchoring/premature-closure/base-rate-neglect/confirmation-bias, confounding and scope.

operational_coherence.rationale: Chain is intelligible and bounded: defined handoff interval (completion to first action) -> discriminating checks (arrivals-to-staffed-hours, clustering, return/reassignment share, time to assignment/open, absence/peak overlap, external-pending, timestamp audit) -> handoff-by-candidate matrix -> ranked retained set -> matched bounded pilot with pre-declared direction under comparable demand/staffing, with elimination only on capable contradicting check. Conditional because named measurements/relations are assumed to-be-verified, not established: stage timestamps meaning, reassignment/return logging, and staffing/queue alignability for the scoped case types and window.

validity.rationale: Mechanism is preserved and target question is addressed with bounded inference, but operational warrant depends on specific unverified measurements. No criterion fails, one is conditional, so Conditional.

target_fidelity.rationale: Directly answers retained question: where is largest handoff intervals per stage/case-type with retained mechanisms and for/against evidence; which bounded changes is matched changes prioritized where retained candidates converge, tested by pilot response in declared direction. Bounded as association/location, not proof, with non-response reopening differential.

unresolved_conditions: Verify stage-level timestamps exist for the named workflow, case types and window and mean what is taken (upstream completion to downstream first action, separate from working time) by auditing ticket histories and comparing logged timestamps to independent traces of the same event; this also tests candidate (j).

Verify reassignment/return/reopen, first-assignment/first-open, pending-on-external, and notification/reminder events are logged and that queue lengths and staffing schedules/absence dates can be joined to the same window to compute arrivals-to-staffed-hours ratio and overlap analyses; if absent, the discriminating checks cannot produce the matrix signal.
